dossier.scp_unleashed.407.title: Song of Genesis
dossier.scp_unleashed.407.caption: The SCP-407 cassette at intake. A green shoot had grown from one reel by the following morning.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: The SCP-407 cassette is kept in a sealed, soundproofed locker. It is never to be loaded into any device that is wired to a speaker.

Personnel who hear any part of SCP-407 are to report to the Site Director at once and must not be left alone until the recording has ended. %rPlayback for testing requires Level 4 approval and a full containment team.%r

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-407 is a recording on a hand-labelled cassette tape, a little over four minutes long. It is a slow, wordless piece for plucked strings, flute and bells, with distant voices that never quite form words. Listeners call it beautiful and find it hard to stop listening.

Anyone who hears SCP-407 through a speaker grows calm and unhurried, and small hurts mend while it plays. As the recording goes on, growth may appear around the listener: moss, bark and pale flowering bulbs that drift with spores.
The growth does not survive the end of the recording. In most cases on file, neither do the people who heard it.

page.title: Addendum 407-1: Test Log
text: Test 407-03: D-5120 listened in a storeroom. Growth covered the walls within two minutes and closed around D-5120, who could no longer move but reported no pain. Small creatures were seen playing among the growth. %rD-5120 was heard laughing.%r
Test 407-04: the recording was played in the east yard. No growth was recorded. A tall figure was. See Addendum 407-2.
Test 407-06: a researcher entered the storeroom partway through playback and was attacked by the figure. %rRecovery of D-5120 was not possible.%r

page.title: Addendum 407-2: The Tall Figure
page.text: On several playbacks a very tall, thin figure of bark and moss has been seen, its face hidden behind a pale wooden mask with branching horns. It is hostile to staff and has been seen catching the smaller creatures and drawing them into itself. It does not outlast the recording either.

page.title: Addendum 407-3: Provenance
page.text: SCP-407 was handed to a reader of this file by the individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. The tape was already labelled. See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp407_cassette.2: Anyone who hears it through a speaker is soothed and slowed. Keep listening, and the room may not stay empty for long.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp407_cassette.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-407 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A stranger in Foundation dress delivers the tape in person.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp407_sprout_spa: Spawns a Genesis Sprout, a small and harmless creature of leaf and bark that hops and chirps. Sprouts from this egg belong to no song.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp407_titan_spaw: Spawns the tall figure from SCP-407's file. It is hostile to people. One from this egg belongs to no song and does not wither on its own.
jade.scp_unleashed.scp407.pod: A living casing of bark and moss

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp407_cassette.i: A hand-labelled cassette holding SCP-407, Song of Genesis, a slow and wordless song. Use it on a Sound Console or a computer, or in the air, to add it to your anomalous recordings.
